system.description:
A powerful two-handed axe, made with high quality, sharp steel. 

Polearmbreaker.
Cleave into an opponent with a brutal weapon attack. Your attack gains +4 Atk and +2 Brk damage. Attacking with this weapon art prevents you from making Extra Attacks.
Protected from Lightning and Wind damage. Vulnerable to Slashing and Decay damage.
Once per map, as a Bonus Action, you may heal 2d6 + Mgt HP and restore 1d4 Stn. At 10th level, gain another 1d6 healing on your HP roll. At 20th level, gain another 1d4 on your Stn recovery roll.
A heavy club carved from hardwood. Cheap, simple and sturdy.
